Record What Built the Project

Source: R/rProject-lock.R
Lock.Rd

Writes .setup/scripts/rproject.lock at make auto, before the project is published. The lock records

  • the rProject that is running (rproject_sha, rproject_version);

  • the image (image, a registry digest, and image_name), read from the running sif's labels;

  • the Posit Package Manager snapshot (snapshot, the image's date) for packages the image lacks, and the R version (r_version);

  • the packages the project adds in project.R (extra_cran, extra_github), with their versions or commits;

  • for a proprietary add-on sif (<name>-plus.sif, built from the public image with Bootstrap: localimage): the sif's name, source, checksum (sif_sha256), and date. CI runs the public image.

make project restores the lock, locally and in GitHub Actions; make upgrade moves rProject forward, and the next make auto records the running image.

Usage

Lock(path)

Arguments

path

Character string. Project path.

Value

Returns the path of the lock file, invisibly, or NULL when nothing was written.

Details

docker-* projects have no lock: their recurring image builds take the newest upstream base and the newest rProject.

Nothing is written in rProject itself (its CI builds rProject from source), or when the running rProject has no commit (installed from a local source).
